newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti shares rise in thin market.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti shares rise in thin market.

text.p: Shares in Italy's information technology group Olivetti rose strongly on Monday in very modest volume largely in a technical recovery from their recent poor performance on the Milan bourse, dealers said.
"The shares have lost much in recent sessions and today in thin volume have shown a partial recovery," said one dealer.
At 1540 GMT, Olivetti gained 3.08 percent to 522 lire after a day's high of 532, with around 9.5 million shares traded and the all-share Mibtel index up 0.17 percent at 10,479.
Dealers noted that Olivetti's chief executive Roberto Colaninno said he will have the company's full recovery plan ready sometime this month, after he took over at the company in September.
Colaninno had said he hoped to sell off the group's loss-making personal computer company by the end of the year, but in late November said this process had been delayed.
